q: In a certain language, a word is coded by the sum of the alphabet positions of its letters multiplied by 100. If FACE is 1400, which word is coded as 1000?
explanation: BEAD = 2+5+1+4 = 10, so the code is 1000.

q: Look at this series: 72, 72, 61, 61, 50, 50, ... What comes next?
explanation: Each pair decreases by 11, so the next term is 39.

q: A man walks 4 km south, turns west and walks 6 km, then turns south and walks 5 km, then turns west and walks 6 km. How far is he from the starting point?
explanation: Net south = 9 km and net west = 12 km, so distance = sqrt(81 + 144) = 15 km.
subject: Logical / Abstract Reasoning

q: Five years ago the average age of P and Q was 25 years. The average age of P, Q and R today is 35 years. How old is R today?
explanation: P + Q = 60 today, P + Q + R = 105, so R = 45.
subject: Logical / Abstract Reasoning

q: If the digits of 4825173 are arranged in descending order from left to right, how many digits remain in the same position?
explanation: Descending gives 8754321; only the digit 5 remains in its original third position.

q: Statements: All pens are tools. Some tools are sharp. Conclusions: (c1) Some pens are sharp. (c2) At least some tools are pens.
explanation: c2 is the valid converse of 'all pens are tools'; c1 is only a possibility.

q: Six numbers are given: 471, 826, 359, 634, 285, 913. If the first and last digits of each are interchanged, which becomes the largest?

A referenced page is not present in main memory
